cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My place card needs 'Chairperson,' not just 'Jo.' You copied my seating plans for years; don't forget how we show rank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone here knows who you are.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've remembered the guests. Now remember who's chairing them. Add the title.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no room on this little card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use two. Name on one, title on the other. There: another layout trick from your teacher. Put the title where they see it first.

reason: Use the claimed pupil relationship to shape the precise authority pursuit, keeping each partner response an actual cause of the next tactic.
